title: console: a UI-preference save during an open clears ElementApiOpenScope, so a nav-bound API read is asked again by the page (double fetch)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

**Defect.** `ElementApiOpenScope` (`ui/packages/react/src/element-data-source/useElementApiDataSource.ts`, around line 237) drops every kept API read on ANY declared data change: `subscribeDataChanges(() => reads.clear())`. During a console open, the shell's own UI-state flushers write `sys_user_preference` through the data adapter:
- `RecentItemsProvider.tsx:303-321` writes `ui.recent`;
- `LastAppProvider.tsx:109-146` writes `ui.app.last`.

`useMutationInvalidationBridge` (`data-invalidation.ts`) turns each save into `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: 'sys_user_preference' })`. The result: when a preference PATCH lands between the nav gate's read of a bound URL and the page element's mount, the page element asks the same URL again. The objectui#13323 rule ("one read per open") is broken by the shell's own bookkeeping, not by any change to data the page shows.

**Measured** on cloud's control-plane console at objectstack `7ae5e0742d45`, with a local pin-smoke stack serving the same console build as CI. Details are in cloud#4926 comment 7080703466.
- The Cloud nav item 环境 and the page/welcome and page/pricing root elements bind `GET /api/v1/cloud/home`.
- With `GET /api/v1/meta/page` delayed 2500 ms, so that the page mounts after the PATCH, the URL is asked twice in 4/4 opens.
- With the same delay and the preference writes aborted, it is asked once in 4/4.
- CI `console-boots` (cloud run 45030148002) hit the window: "control-plane call budget (cloud#2914)", with `cloud/home` asked twice and 25 calls against a budget of 24.

**Why now.** The clear-on-any-change rule dates from 2026-11-11, so the defect is latent. What changed is how often an open writes preferences: both keys are the writers that #36341 (`a57efdecee1`, per-organization browser copies) rewrote. 16 earlier green `console-boots` runs never wrote during the open. Bisect NOT MEASURED (disk).

**Reach.** Every host that binds a nav item and a page to the same API URL gets a duplicate read whenever the race hits. Cloud's binding is the ruled cloud#3002 design. Cloud's call-budget gate goes flaky until this is fixed. Cloud will not raise its budget or dedupe on its side (cloud#2914).

**Fix shape (proposal).** Keep the open's API reads across the shell's own UI-state writes. Either `ElementApiOpenScope` ignores changes to `sys_user_preference` (or to any object the shell writes as UI state), or the preference adapter's save stops announcing through the data-invalidation bus, since no page displays that data. Regression pin: an open where a preference save lands between the nav read and the page mount asks the URL once.

Re-check: `git grep -n "subscribeDataChanges(() => reads.clear())" -- ui/packages/react/src/element-data-source/useElementApiDataSource.ts` still hits with no object filter ⇒ the defect is present.
